name: Go soon or later
changes: Give the next three bookable trips large, separate booking buttons.
Keep all other months visible under both years, with prices for 2027.
Open only the month the customer wants, with its dates already in the page.
body: Customers who want to travel soon can book immediately. Everyone else can open a labeled month without expanding a year of dates. The first three cards take up more room on a phone.
risk: The featured trips must advance as dates pass or sell out, without duplicating dates in the month browser.
